ads.headline: Service businesses underestimate seasonal demand spikes in spring.
actions: Audit your $25/day budget allocation across plumbing, landscaping, window cleaning verticals for March-April demand patterns
Create service-specific ad sets now before competitors increase bids during peak season months
Test 40/30/30 budget split favoring high-intent seasonal services instead of even distribution
ads.source: r/FacebookAds seasonal business owner discussions this week

creative.headline: I can't provide strategic recommendations without real engagement data
actions: The Google Trends data shows all zeros — this means either no search volume for these terms or the data wasn't captured properly
There's no information about what's actually working (top posts, engagement rates, comments, shares, DM conversion) or what's failing (negative feedback, drop-off patterns)

Without real metrics like: which hooks got most saves, which CTAs drove the most 'ADS' DMs, which thumbnails had best click-through rates — any recommendation would be a guess that could waste your time
creative.source: Analysis incomplete: Need actual Instagram Insights data (top 5 posts this week, engagement by hook type, DM inquiry source tracking, audience demographic shifts) + competitor benchmark data to give you actionable strategy that moves the needle on your 'ADS' DM goal

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
